verdict.rationale: Skyvern's browser-sessions docs say a VNC stream lets you watch or take control of a running browser at any point. They also describe human-in-the-loop pauses that keep browser state, so cookies, tabs and the current page persist and the run picks up where it stopped. This covers both watching live and taking over mid-run. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the takeover/hand-back workflow (e.g., how the agent resumes after a human intervenes or how a stuck agent signals for help), independent or hands-on corroboration of live takeover.
